openers.text: Does your organization acknowledge in writing that people use AI in their work?

options.label: Yes, written policy exists naming AI use.
Partial. AI is mentioned but not governed.
No written acknowledgment, but people use AI here.
People do not use AI here.

na_probe.prompt: You indicated people do not use AI in your organization. A quick check before we record that. In the last 30 days, has anyone on staff used a general-purpose chatbot (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot), AI-assisted search, transcription, translation, code completion, summarization, image generation, or a productivity feature that runs on an LLM?

options.label: Confirmed. No such use. Report this vector as N/A.
Actually yes, at least one of those applies. Revise my answer.

openers.text: In which of the following does your organization operate, sell to customers, or employ people? Select all that apply.

options.label: California, Colorado, Utah, or New York City

na_probe.prompt: You selected 'None of the above.' A quick check. Does your organization sell to, employ, or serve anyone located in the EU, UK, California, Colorado, Utah, or New York City, even occasionally or remotely?

options.label: Confirmed. No exposure. Report Regulation as N/A.
Actually yes, at least one applies. Let me reselect.

openers.text: Does your organization operate digital systems reachable from outside the organization?

options.label: Yes, employees and known partners only. No public surface.

na_probe.prompt: You indicated no external-facing digital systems. A quick check. Does your organization have any website, booking form, contact page, customer portal, mobile app, or API endpoint reachable from the public internet?

options.label: Confirmed. Fully internal. Report Infrastructure as N/A.
Actually yes, something is reachable. Revise my answer.

Infrastructure.text: Has your organization completed a scan of its digital surfaces for AI agent readiness?

Based on scan findings, has your organization deployed machine-readable declarations (llms.txt, structured data, agent-legible identifiers) on any critical surface, and confirmed the change with a follow-up scan?
Do agent-readiness scans run on a declared cadence, with drift between scans tracked?
Does the organization maintain a declared framework-review cadence for agent-readiness practices, with a review artifact from the most recent cycle?
Are new deployments or releases automatically scored for agent readiness at release time?

Regulation.text: Has your organization built an obligation register that maps AI-specific regulatory requirements to the jurisdictions where you operate, sell, or employ?
Have the obligations in your register been translated into controls, with traceability from statute to control, for at least one jurisdiction?
Do controls cover all in-scope jurisdictions, with active monitoring of regulatory change and documented interpretations of ambiguous requirements?
Does the organization maintain a declared framework-review cadence for its regulatory compliance practices, with a review artifact from the most recent cycle?
Is regulatory coverage refreshed continuously as a measured ratio, with a defined workflow to ingest a new jurisdiction in days rather than months?

options.label: Both continuous refresh and rapid intake.

People.text: Has your organization completed a baseline assessment of how people actually use AI in their work, a measurement of behavior rather than a survey of attitudes?
In the last year, has any policy, training, or practice change traced back to findings from a behavioral AI assessment?
Does your organization measure AI-collaboration behavior at a cohort level (across teams or functions), with privacy-preserving aggregation, on a recurring cadence?
Does the organization maintain a declared framework-review cadence for its AI-collaboration practices, with a review artifact from the most recent cycle?
Is behavioral AI assessment continuous (not episodic) and paired with a verifiable attestation mechanism?
